blocks.text: Waves ka diffraction obstacles (rukawaton) ke tez kinaron ya corners (konon) ke gird waves ka bend hona (mudna), ya kisi barrier (rukawat) ke aage waves ka phail jana hai. Yeh tab hota hai jab wave kisi barrier ya opening, yani slit (surakh), se guzre jis ka size wave ki wavelength ke qareeb ho. Wavelength jitni lambi, spreading (phailao) utni zyada; aur wavelength chhoti, to spreading kam.

blocks.alt: Rukawat mein ek jaisa gap, do khaake. Baen: qareeb qareeb seedhe wavefronts (chhoti wavelength) gap se guzar kar thora sa phailte hain: Small wavelength, Small diffraction. Daen: door door wavefronts (lambi wavelength) chaure aadhe daire bana kar phailte hain: Large wavelength, Large diffraction.
blocks.caption: Slit se diffraction (PDF page 157): chhoti wavelength, kam diffraction; lambi wavelength, zyada diffraction (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gap wahi hai, sirf wavelength badli hai. Jitni wavelength gap ke muqable mein lambi, utna wave (lehar) mur kar phailti hai. Isi liye sound (lambi wavelength) darwaze ke gird mur jati hai magar light (bohat chhoti wavelength) nahi.
Diffraction har qism ki waves mein dekha ja sakta hai: pani ki waves, sound waves, light waves aur electromagnetic waves.

items: Corners ke peeche ya darwaze ke raaste sound sun lena, chahe sound kahin aur paida hui ho, kyunke sound waves corners ke gird mud jati hain.
Crystals se X-rays ka diffraction, kyunke crystal mein atoms ki regular (baqaida) rows (qataron) ka beech ka faasla X-rays ki wavelength jitna hota hai.

blocks.text: Diffraction waves ke behaviour (rawayye) ka basic (bunyadi) hissa hai aur different (alag alag) fields (shobon) mein is ki bohat si practical applications hain.

Fig. 7.11 mein ripple tank dikhaya gaya hai. Yeh bohat useful apparatus (aala) hai: is se pani ki waves banai jati hain, aur waves ki properties (khasusiyat) jaise reflection, diffraction aur refraction bhi dikhayi jati hain.

blocks.alt: Ripple tank: chaar tangon wale frame mein sheeshe ke tale wali pani ki tray. Stand ki lakri ki patiyon se elastic bands par latka vibrator pani ki surface (satah) ko chhoota hai. Stand par lagi lamp oopar se light dalti hai aur neeche farsh par safed screen par waves (lehrein) ka pattern banta hai. Labels: Lamp, Stand, Vibrator, Water surface, Elastic bands, Frame, Glass bottomed tray, Leg, Wave pattern on screen, White screen.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.11: Ripple tank (kitab ki Figure 7.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Ripple tank mein pani, ek vibrator (jaise motor se hilne wali sui), obstacles (jaise chhota rectangular block ya aadhi gol deewar) aur different width (chaurai) ke gaps hote hain. Vibrator se concentric (ek hi centre wale) circles (daire) ya parallel (seedhi) waves banti hain. Obstacle rakh kar ek khaas width ka gap banaya jata hai, aur experiment different width ke gaps ke saath dohraya ja sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Rukawat ke gap tak aate seedhe wavefronts, do khaake. Baen: tang gap, aage waves aadhe dairon mein phailti hain: Small gap, Increased diffraction. Daen: chaura gap, aage waves zyada tar seedhi, sirf kinaron par mudti hain: Large gap, Decreased diffraction.
blocks.caption: Tang gap, zyada diffraction; chaura gap, kam diffraction (kitab ki Figure 7.11 ke sath chhape khaakon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Ripple tank mein lamp ki light waves ke crests aur troughs ka shadow (saya) neeche safed screen par dalti hai. Gap wavelength ke barabar ya chhota ho to waves khoob mudti hain (semicircles, aadhe daire); gap bara ho to waves seedhi guzarti hain.

Dekha jata hai ke jab gap ki width wavelength ke muqable mein chhoti ho to diffraction zyada hota hai aur waves obstacle ke gird mud kar aadhe daire (semicircle) jaisa pattern banati hain. Jaise jaise gap wavelength ke muqable mein wide (chaura) hota hai, diffraction kam hota jata hai aur waves kam mud kar gap se guzar jati hain.
Yeh experiment ripple tank mein gap ki width ka diffraction par effect dikhata hai, aur batata hai ke gap ki width aur wavelength ka relation waves ke behaviour par kaise effect dalta hai.

blocks.caption: Gap ki width aur diffraction (khulasa)
rows: zyada (significant) diffraction; waves mud kar aadhi gol shakal mein phailti hain
thora diffraction; waves kam mud kar guzarti hain

blocks.title: For your Information (aap ki maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text: Ek bareek diffraction grating se white light ka diffraction: white light different rangon mein phail jati hai (kitab is ki tasveer dikhati hai).

blocks.title: Example 7.6
blocks.problem: Ripple tank mein ek wave generator 10 s mein 500 pulses banata hai. Pulses ki frequency nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: n = 500 pulses, t = 10 s; f = ?
Ek pulse ka waqt (time period): T = t/n = 10 s/500 = 1/50 s = 0.02 s.

blocks.title: Interesting Information (dilchasp maloomat)
blocks.text: Compact disc (CD) par bohat bareek lines (rulings) hoti hain, har ek 0.5 μm chauri; yeh diffraction grating ka kaam karti hain. Jab white light ka chhota source disc par parta hai to diffracted light coloured lanes (rang daar patiyan) banati hai, jo in lines ke diffraction patterns ke milne se banti hain.

blocks.prompt: Waves ke diffraction se kya matlab hai, aur ripple tank kis purpose (maqsad) ke liye istemal hota hai (short question 7.7; MCQ 7.11)? Hum kone ke peeche kisi ko sun kyun sakte hain magar dekh kyun nahi sakte?
blocks.explanation: Diffraction obstacles ke gird waves ka mudna aur wavelength ke qareeb size ki openings se un ka phailna hai. Ripple tank pani ki waves banata hai aur reflection, refraction aur diffraction dikhata hai; different width ke gaps se dikhata hai ke narrow (tang) gap waves ko khoob phailata hai aur wide gap mushkil se. Sound ki wavelengths (centimetres se metres) darwazon aur konon ke qareeb hain, to sound un ke gird mudti hai, jabke light ki wavelengths (taqreeban 0.5 μm) kahin chhoti hain, to light mushkil se mudti hai.

items: Diffraction: barrier ke kinaron ke gird waves ka mudna aur opening se aage phailna; opening wavelength jitna ho to zyada.
Lambi wavelength, zyada spreading: sound konon ke gird mud jati hai; crystals X-rays ka diffraction karte hain.
Ripple tank: chhota gap, zyada diffraction; bara gap, kam diffraction.
Example 7.6: 10 s mein 500 pulses, f = 50 pulses s⁻¹.
